facts.text: Under Utica's Four-Year Graduation Guarantee, students who fulfill their responsibilities but cannot graduate on time take remaining required courses free of tuition and fee charges.

sources.title: Four-Year Graduation Guarantee - Utica University
sources.quote: If you have met your responsibilities and are not able to graduate in four years, provide you the opportunity to complete any courses required for your degree, free of any tuition and fee charges.
